idea.idea_text: An AI-powered learning platform that creates personalized learning paths for students based on their knowledge level, learning speed, and career goals. The platform recommends courses, generates quizzes, tracks learning progress, provides AI tutoring, and identifies weak concepts requiring additional practice. Teachers can monitor student performance through an analytics dashboard while students receive adaptive study plans.
